title: RIMS：面向小规模LLM检索增强生成的平滑多对偏好优化
summary: 提出RIMS框架，用于小规模语言模型（SLM）的检索增强生成（RAG）。通过三阶段偏好优化：合成思维链偏好数据、可微平滑聚合机制替代硬选择、偏好优化。理论证明平滑近似可控误差界，梯度对齐更紧。在四个多跳问答基准上，在噪声检索条件下优于现有方法。
summary_en: Proposes RIMS, a three-stage preference optimization framework for small-scale LLM RAG: synthetic CoT preference data generation, differentiable soft aggregation replacing hard selection, and preference optimization. Theoretically shows controllable error bound and tighter gradient alignment. Outperforms baselines on four multi-hop QA benchmarks under noisy retrieval.
